description.text: The fifth XY set and the first after Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire, released on 4 February 2015 with 164 cards: 160 and four secret Trainers. It brought Hoenn back with Primal Reversion, in Primal Groudon-EX and Primal Kyogre-EX, and Ancient Traits, extra traits that work whenever the Pokémon is in play. Mega Gardevoir-EX and Mega Aggron-EX are among its 12 new Pokémon-EX, and its theme decks are Earth's Pulse and Ocean's Core.
